**Finding submitted — T4C: deviation (preferred-level cure proposed).**

- **Responsive clauses reviewed:** 14.1 Term (p0746), 14.2.1–14.2.10 (p0749–p0781), plus the cross-reference to 14.2.10 at p0437.
- **Why it fails fallback:** PB's sole at-will right (14.2.2) is gated on SFJ having funded $60M of Development Costs and closes at first Regulatory Approval, with a redacted notice period — so across a Term running to the last Approval Payment, PB has no exercisable convenience exit at either the preferred (30 days) or fallback (60–90 days) standard.
- **Boundary calls:** SFJ's exits under 14.2.3 (Material Adverse Event), 14.2.6 (Change of Control) and 14.2.10 (JSC deadlock) are event-triggered, not convenience terminations, so they are not flagged as Vendor T4C rights; I avoided deleting 14.2.10, which would have dangled the cross-reference at p0437. The 300% Development Cost payment is a fallback-level fee-cap issue only, so it is raised commercially in the comment rather than redlined at the preferred level.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** one surgical replace in 14.2.2 giving unconditional convenience termination on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts, plus a short new 14.2.11 confirming SFJ has no convenience termination right during the Term.
